paragraphs: I contributed to building scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker. This experience has equipped me with a deep understanding of model deployment and API integration.
I developed an XGBoost churn classifier in R using tidymodels, incorporating a two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE within the recipe, and evaluating with Matthews Correlation Coefficient.
I have not used FastAPI for deployment yet, but I am eager to learn and apply this tool to streamline our model deployment processes.
Could we schedule a call to discuss how my experience with model building and deployment can contribute to Quantcast's AI-powered technology?
